methods.native_objective: Mean residual activation difference between matched positive and negative behavior responses, added at the specified layer and positions.
adaptation_notes: Official LlamaWrapper hardcodes Llama paths, INST formatting, instruction-end markers, tuple outputs and answer extraction position -2.
Qwen3 requires explicit template, Tensor-output and answer-position adaptations; no such edits were made.
E1 input-pair differences alone are not the original behavior-answer contrast. Added task supervision must be labelled task-adapted.
